Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are at the crease. Kagiso Rabada will start proceedings with the ball for the Proteas. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Bangladesh has a chance of creating history at Centurion! Their bowlers have done an incredible job of restricting the Proteas to 154 and it is now onto their batters to show some composure and take Bangladesh to a famous victory. Do join us for their reply which begins shortly.

The man of the moment, Taskin Ahmed is up for a quick chat. He says he is very happy. Adds, he just stuck to his process and indicates there was some extra bounce which helped him. Tells that he has been believing in the process for many years and that is the key to his success.

Bangladesh would be over the moon right now! They pulled things back in their favor after leaking runs at the start and it was Mehidy Hasan who got them the breakthrough. Although, it was Taskin Ahmed who stole the show as he kept the batters on their toes and picked wickets in a cluster for his side. This is the second 5-wicket haul for Taskin Ahmed in ODIs. The previous time he took a Michelle, it was in 2014 against India in Dhaka, but his team stumbled to 58 all out, chasing a 'meager' total of 106 as a certain Stuart Binny ran havoc. This time, the target is bigger but the conditions look pretty good to script a famous overseas match and series win for Bangladesh.

South Africa got off to a good start and it was Janneman Malan who was the aggressor for them. Quinton de Kock perished while trying to up the ante and after that nothing went the Proteas' way. Wickets kept tumbling for them and they completely lost the plot. Miller and Dwaine Pretorius showed some resistance but they too got out after getting a start. If not for Keshav Maharaj, South Africa would have failed to cross even the 130-run mark. He finished as their second-highest run-scorer and that sums up their story.

What a splendid bowling performance this has been from Bangladesh! They have been absolutely brilliant with the ball and South Africa have now recorded their lowest-ever ODI total against Bangladesh. At one point, the Proteas were cruising along as the openers stitched together a good partnership of 46 runs. However, they lost 10 wickets for just 108 runs and it is the tourists who have dominated the proceedings and history beckons for them.

OUT! RUN OUT! That will be the end of South Africa's inning. A flatter ball, around off. Maharaj knocks it to point and tries to keep the strike with a quick single but Shamsi was not ready for the call. Tamim Iqbal at point throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs and the replay shows Maharaj was well short. South Africa are all-out for 154.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Quicker one, on middle. Shamsi plays it around the corner.
A loopy ball, on off. Shamsi defends it.
On middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Length and on off, pushed to covers.

Dropped! An absolute sitter! This is short and on middle. Maharaj looks to pull but gets a top edge, high in the air and towards mid-wicket. Yasir Ali tries to reverse-cup it over his head and spills it out. Bangladesh would hope that this doesn't cost them much. The batters take a single.
A length ball, on middle. Maharaj mistimes his pull to mid-wicket. He shouts in frustration.
A length ball, outside off. Shamsi dabs it to third man for a single.
A full toss, on off, pushed to long off for a single. 150 up for South Africa!
FOUR! Valuable! A length ball, around off. Maharaj stands tall and hammers it through mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, drifting on middle, Shamsi tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Maharaj defends on the front foot.
Flatter and outside off. Maharaj punches it to covers.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A needless shot from Ngidi and South Africa lose their ninth wicket now. Clever bowling from the veteran, Shakib Al Hasan though! He serves a loopy ball, on a length, around off. Ngidi skips down a bit and looks to heave it across the line. He miscues it high in the air towards the mid off region. Najmul Hossain Shanto (sub) runs in from the deep, dives forward and takes a really good catch. Ngidi is absolutely gutted as he walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Najmul Hossain Shanto b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker, going on with the arm, from off. Lungi Ngidi keeps it out.
Full and outside off. Keshav Maharaj drives it wide of long off and takes a single.
A quicker ball, around off. Maharaj rocks back and pushes it towards point.
Islam goes back to over the wicket and serves a bumper, around leg. Lungi Ngidi ducks underneath.
A length ball, angling in from outside off. Lungi Ngidi lets it be. The ball goes just past the off pole.
Good-length delivery, around off. Lungi Ngidi pushes it towards cover.
Tap and run! This is on a length, around off. Keshav Maharaj drops it towards point and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Nicely done! Islam serves a short ball, around off. Maharaj stays back and pulls it uppishly in front of square and fetches himself another boundary.
Fuller in length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj drags it towards mid on where the fielder runs to his left and puts in a dive to stop the ball.
Floated, full and on off. Lungi Ngidi blocks it out.
Slightly shorter in length and going on with the angle from off. Keshav Maharaj gets inside the line of the ball and pushes it through cover for a single.
Darted on the pads. Keshav Maharaj wrists it to mid-wicket.
This is tossed up, around off. Keshav Maharaj defends it off the front foot.
A bit quicker, on a length, around off. Keshav Maharaj gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it.
Flatter ball, around off. Keshav Maharaj keeps it out.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj hangs back and pushes it through cover for one run.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter in length, outside off. Maharaj stays back and cuts it in front of square on the off side and bags a boundary. Precious runs for the Proteas!
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Keshav Maharaj prods and defends it towards point.
Fizz hits the deck hard, around off. Keshav Maharaj covers the line of the ball and gets solid in his defence.
On a length, around off. Keshav Maharaj taps it to the off side.
A length ball, around off and keeping a bit low. Maharaj does well to bring his bat down in time.
BEATEN! Slightly shorter in length and jagging back in late. Lungi Ngidi hangs back to keep it out but the ball zips past his outside edge.
A bit fuller this time, around off. Ngidi looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards backward point.
A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Lungi Ngidi lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Lungi Ngidi covers the line and blocks it to the off side.
A short ball, around off. Keshav Maharaj pulls it in front of square towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! A full ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj sits back and smashes it through the cover region for a boundary. South Africa need many more of these!
Full and well outside off. A big swing and a miss from Ngidi.
Fuller and angling on middle. Ngidi drops it on the leg side.
Full, slower and outside off. Ngidi lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Edged and just flies away from the fielder! A length ball, outside off. Maharaj looks to push with hard hands and it takes the outside edge and goes away from the diving gully fielder for a single.
On a length and on off. Maharaj tucks it to mid-wicket.
Lungi Ngidi walks out to bat. Also, Mushfiqur Rahim walks off the field now as he seems to have hurt his right shoulder. Not a good sign for Bangladesh.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Five-fer for Taskin Ahmed! He is gone off for a celebration! Fantastic from Ahmed. This is on a length and around off. Rabada is squared up as he looks to defend and it takes an outside edge to Mushfiqur Rahim, behind the sticks who takes it with ease. Rabada is just told to wait as the third umpire wants to take a look if Rahim has grabbed that cleanly. Mushfiqur Rahim took it low but the ball went into his mitts quite nicely. He has damaged his shoulder a bit while celebrating the wicket and the physio is called up.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! EDGED! A length ball, angling around off. Rabada looks to defend but it takes the outside edge past first slip for a boundary. Inches away from the fielder.
Length and outside off. Rabada leaves it alone.
Kagiso Rabada walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Taskin Ahmed is bowling with fire here. Short of a length and around leg. Miller looks to flick it but is a touch late and the ball takes some glove before going to the right of the keeper, Mushfiqur Rahim. Bangladesh appeal and up goes the finger. Miller knew he had something on it but tries to fade away but as soon as he saw the finger go up, he started to walk. The set-batter is gone and here comes the tail-ender. Bangladesh will love to hear that.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around off. Keshav punches it to deep cover for a single.
On a length, on off. Miller punches with hard hands and to mid off. The batters take a quick single.
Length ball, slanting outside off. Maharaj with a good leave.
Slower one at 112 kph, on middle. Miller tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
Length and outside off. Miller was slightly tempted to play that but leaves it alone in the end.
Fullish and outside off. Miller knocks it to mid off this time.
Fuller and on off, pushed back to Rahman.
FOUR LEG BYES! A length ball, angling on the pads. Miller misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls past the diving keeper and into the fine leg fence.
A single to end the over as this is flicked off the pads to square leg.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A length ball, outside off. A back-foot punch from Miller and the ball bounces over cover and races into the fence.
Length and slanting around middle. Miller defends it straight down the ground.
On the pads this time. Miller misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal from Ahmed but that was clearly missing the leg stump.
Length ball, around off. Maharaj punches off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Maharaj bends back and lets it through.
Length and angling on middle. Maharaj defends with the bat and pad together and hits it to square leg for a single.
A yorker but the pace was lacking there, Maharaj has time to defend this.
Length and outside off, shaping away. Maharaj leaves it.
Length, slower and around off. Miller opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man for a single.
Length and around off. Miller prods and works it to point.
Length ball, angling on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
A very low full toss, on middle. Keshav Maharaj drags it towards mid on.
On a length, around the fifth stump channel. Keshav Maharaj does not bother playing at that one.
Back of a length, around off. Keshav Maharaj keeps it out.
Keshav Maharaj comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! AND AGAIN! Taskin Ahmed comes back to bowl and he gets the breakthrough for Bangladesh! Taskin bags his third wicket and South Africa lose their sixth wicket for just 107 runs. The tourists are bossing this game at the moment. Taskin serves a full ball, well outside off. Dwaine Pretorius goes chasing after it and looks to slap it through cover. However, he only manages to get an outside edge which goes straight to Mushfiqur Rahim behind the sticks. The keeper makes no mistake and Pretorius is a goner. Taskin takes off for a celebration and the crowd erupts yet again.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle. David Miller stays back and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off and staying a touch low. Miller looks to slash hard at it but the ball sneaks through his bat.
A yorker-length ball, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius digs it out to the off side.
Good-length ball, angling in from off. Dwaine Pretorius defends it towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius psuhes it towards cover. Not in the gap though!
Edged but safe! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius prods to block but it takes the outside edge and falls way short of the keeper. Lovely changeup from the Fizz!
Back of a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius works it behind square on the off side and takes a couple of runs.

An appeal for LBW but turned down! Mustafizur Rahman comes 'round the wicket and serves a good-length ball that angles in late. Dwaine Pretorius misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. Bangladesh think of taking a review but go against it in the end.
Slower through the air, full and on off. David Miller prods and keeps it out.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Dwaine Pretorius punches it through mid-wicket and hands the strike back to Miller.
Darted on the pads. Pretorius tucks it around the corner and comes back for the second run.
Hasan goes 'round the wicket and serves it on a length, around middle. Dwaine Pretorius hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, on a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius reaches out and taps it towards cover.
SIX! BANG! Take that, says Dwaine Pretorius! This is tossed up, around off. Pretorius gets to the pitch of the ball and smokes it way over long off for a biggie. 100 comes up for South Africa!
Mehidy Hasan (4-0-18-1) is back on.

Flatter and quicker, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius cuts it towards backward point and sets off for a quick single. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the keeper's end but Miller had made it home.
Floated, on a length, around off. Dwaine Pretorius gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
Full and around off. Dwaine Pretorius gets solid in his front foot defence.
On a length, around middle. Dwaine Pretorius tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and Dwaine Pretorius smashes it! This is dragged down, around off. Pretorius goes back in his crease and slaps it past the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Tosses it up, around off. Dwaine Pretorius gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, around off. Miller covers his off pole and dabs it onto the deck. Just 1 run off the over!
Islam goes back to over the wicket for Miller. He hurls a good-length ball, around off. Miller gets forward and blocks it back to the bowler.
A full ball, around middle and leg. Dwaine Pretorius flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Islam comes 'round the wicket now and serves it on a length, outside off. Dwaine Pretorius prods and pushes it to cover where the fielder dives to his right and saves a few runs.
A slower bumper, angling across the batter, from off. Dwaine Pretorius sways away from the line of the delivery.
Back of a length, around off. Dwaine Pretorius keeps it out.
Another easy single as Pretorius pushes it to long off.
Flatter and around off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Around off again. Pretorius waits and punches it sweetly to sweeper cover for a single.
Angles it around off. Pretorius defends with soft hands.
Slower through the air, angling outside off. Pretorius hits it to point.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
Short in length, around off. Miller mistimes his punch to mid off.
On the pads, flicked wide of deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Length ball, outside off, punched to covers.
Around off. Pretorius punches it to deep covers for a single.
Length and on middle. Pretorius blocks it on the leg side.
Dwaine Pretorius is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shoriful Islam gets back into the attack and into the wickets column straightaway. Superb catch by Mehidy Hasan! Bangladesh are all over South Africa right now! Short of a length, sliding around off, there is some extra bounce as well. van der Dussen looks to defend but gets surprised by the extra bounce. The ball takes the shoulder of the bat and balloons towards point. Mehidy Hasan charges forward and takes it sharply. The man in form, van der Dussen goes back cheaply.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Miller is off the mark! Fuller and on middle. Miller reverse-hits it, over point for a boundary.
Again down the leg side. Miller tucks it to mid-wicket. Miller wanted a single but is sent back.
Wide! Goes down the leg side. Miller misses his flick.
Very full and outside off. Miller dead bats it.
This time van der Dussen finds the gap and hits it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller and on off. van der Dussen gets low as he punches it to covers.
Tossed up, on off, pushed to covers.
Length ball, outside off. Miller leans and blocks it out.
Length and on off. Miller on the front foot, defends it.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler. Ahmed throws it back to the striker's end. Why not, he is pumped up now.
Length ball, slanting across, outside off. Miller shoulders arms to it.
Five wides! Bonus runs and South Africa will take it with open arms! Short ball, down the leg aside and not in the keeper's reach as well. Miller ducks and the ball races behind to the fence.
Length and on off. van der Dussen wrists it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on off. van der Dussen defends it out.
Full and on middle. Miller turns it to mid-wicket.
David Miller walks out to bat now.

OUT LBW! Bavuma takes the LBW decision upstairs. It looked plumb to the naked eye though. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wickets hitting and the on-field decision stays. The Proteas are 4 down now. This is exceptional bowling from Bangladesh! Shakib Al Hasan serves an arm ball, fuller and coming with the angle around middle and leg. Bavuma gets low to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Bavuma takes it upstairs but can only retain the review here. It is the Bangladeshi fans at SuperSport Park who are making the noise righ tnow.
Slower ball, around off. Bavuma waits and plays it to point.
Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Slightly full and on off, van der Dussen strokes it to covers.
Tossed up, on middle. van der Dussen lunges and blocks it.

Back of a length, just outside off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it towards cover and sets off for a quick run. The fielder there gets towards the ball, and has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. Rassie van der Dussen is off the mark straightaway!
Rassie van der Dussen walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Taskin Ahmed is on a roll! He has pulled things back in Bangladesh's favour and this time, it is the set batter in Janneman Malan who has to take the long walk back to the pavilion. Coming to the ball - This was a good-length delivery, around the fifth stump channel. Malan sits back and has a tentative poke at it. Probably tried to push it through covers. Although, it takes the outside edge and goes towards Mushfiqur Rahim behind the sticks who takes a simple catch moving to his right. South Africa are in a spot of bother now after getting off to a good start.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: This is a length ball, angling in from off. Janneman Malan stays back and works it to cover.
On a length, around off. Janneman Malan sits back and drives it on the up, without much timing back past the diving bowler towards mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan hangs back and taps it towards backward point.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Temba Bavuma prods and pushes it through the cover region for a run.
Finally, Bavuma gets off the mark! Tossed up, outside off. Bavuma drives it to long off for a single.
On a length, around off. Temba Bavuma keeps it out, on the off side.
That stayed a touch low! Flatter and quicker, around off. Bavuma rocks back to cut but the ball stays a bit low and he adjusts well to tap it towards point.
An overpitched ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma whips it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Tosses it up, around off. Bavuma leans forward and blocks it.
Floated, full and outside off. Janneman Malan prods and drives it towards deep cover for a run.
Good-length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma skips down and just eases it towards mid-wicket. End of a successful over for Bangladesh!
On a length, just outside off. Temba Bavuma gets forward and dabs it towards point, by opening the face of the bat.
A full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma prods and works it towards mid on.
Temba Bavuma is the new bater in.

OUT! Dragged on! The ploy to bring back the pacer into the attack from the other end has done wonders for Bangladesh! Taskin Ahmed strikes and South Africa lose their second wicket now. This was a short-of-a-length delivery, just outside off. Kyle hangs back, gets low and looks to cut hard. It hits the bottom edge of his bat and the ball crashes onto the leg stump. A bonus wicket here for Bangladesh and they are elated!
Back of a length, around off. Kyle gets on top of the bounce and keeps it out.
FOUR! Pulled away! A short ball, around off. Kyle Verreynne sits back in his crease and pulls it in front of square to bag a boundary.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Kyle punches it towards the cover fielder. The fielder there gets to his left but slips as he tries to throw it to the keeper. A single taken.
Fuller in length and outside off. Janneman Malan drags this towards long off for a single.
Tosses it up, around off and turning away late. Janneman Malan blocks it towards point.
A flatter ball, around middle and leg. Kyle rocks back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Kyle skips down the track and works it towards the extra cover fielder, on the bounce.
Full and around off. Kyle Verreynne looks to go inside-out but it hits the toe end of his bat and goes back to the bowler who fails to stop it cleanly. Shakib gets hit on the left knee.
This is darted on the pads. Kyle sits back and wrists it past the square leg fielder for a single.
Shorter in length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne cuts hard but finds the cover fielder. Four dots in a row!
Flatter ball, on middle. Kyle Verreynne skips down the track and works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Kyle Verreynne rocks back and wrists it a bit uppishly towards mid-wicket.
Floated, full and around off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it straight back to the bowler.
This is a flatter ball, around middle. Janneman Malan tucks it to the leg side for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! Bangladesh can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.
Just a single off the over, good one from Ahmed! Full and around middle, Verreynne works it to point.
Length ball, on off, it is nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, good seam position, outside off. Malan knocks it to covers.
Full and on off, driven nicely but straight to covers.
Short of a length, width outside off. Malan is happy to leave it.
Length ball, stays low and around off. Malan hangs back to block it.
A single to end the over as this full ball is flicked to deep square leg.
Tossed up, full and on off. Malan prods and defends.
Darted on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller and on off. Malan steps forward and drives it through the gap, to covers for a boundary. His 7th boundary already.
On middle. Blocked out.
A flatter ball, sliding down the leg side, tucked to square leg for a single.
Angles a length ball, on middle. Malan defends with a straight bat.
Length and outside off. Verreynne chops it to third man for a single. 50 up!
Fuller and around off. Malan miscues his drive and it goes off the inside edge to mid-wicket. A single is taken.
This one is good! Length ball, near the 4th stump channel. Malan watchfully leaves it.
Wide! Not a good start from Ahmed! Length and way outside off, Malan shoulders arms to it.
Length and outside off. Malan offers no shot.
This is again way outside off. Malan leaves it alone and Ahmed got away with this one.
Wide! Starts with a length ball, way outside off. Left alone.
Taskin Ahmed comes into the attack now.
Tossed up, around off. Verreynne pushes to the right of the bowler.
Kyle Verreynne walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! First one bites the dust and Hasan is absolutely elated. It was a much needed wicket as South Africa were scoring runs too easily. A fuller ball, on middle, the ball just turns a bit away. de Kock tries to go over mid on but it goes off the splice and towards long off. Mahmudullah runs forward and to his left to take it. Quinton de Kock goes back for a cheap score.
FOUR! Good shot! This is short and outside off. de Kock slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Very full and on middle. Malan uses his feet as he drills it to long on for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Malan turns it to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, it is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Keeps it tight, around off. Malan dabs it to short third man.
Islam comes over the wicket! Length and angling on off. Malan punches it to covers.
Better from Islam! On middle, on a length. Malan keeps it out on the leg side.
FOUR! Two in a row! Full and on the leg stump. Malan hangs back and whips it past mid on for a boundary.

FOUR! Boundaries are flowing for South Africa! A length ball, around off. Malan comes down the track and pushes with soft hands, the ball goes off the outer half of the bat and through point for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, pushed to the right of mid off for a single.
Floated, full and on middle. Janneman Malan gets forward and turns it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
On a length, around off. Janneman Malan tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Slightly short and Malan pounces on it! Shorter in length, outside off. Malan rocks back and cuts it through the cover-point region to bag a boundary. He is certainly looking in good touch.
Floated, full and around off. Janneman Malan pushes it back to the bowler who half-stops it.
This is full and outside off. Malan drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Hasan starts with a tossed up delivery, around off. Malan prods and defends it to the off side.
Mehidy Hasan is brought into the attack.
Rahman goes full and around middle and leg. Janneman Malan just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a single. He will retain the strike.
Another ball, on a length, just outside off. Janneman Malan prods and pushes it towards cover.
FOUR LEG BYES! Short of a length, around leg. Malan misses his flick. The ball brushes off his thigh pad and races away to the fence.
On a length, around off. Janneman Malan keeps it out.
Chopped on, almost! A length ball, around off. Quinton de Kock looks to dab it towards point but it goes off the inside edge past the leg stump for a run.
FOUR! WHACKED! Back of a length, well outside off. Quinton de Kock sits back and caresses it through the cover-point region for a boundary. Three boundaries in a row for South Africa.
FOUR! Glorious! Lovely timing on that! This is a length ball, angling across the batter from off. Malan leans and just checks his shot back past the bowler for a boundary.

FOUR! A bit streaky but Malan will take that! Back of a length, outside off and just holding a bit in the surface. Janneman Malan stays back and cuts it aerially past the point fielder. The ball races away to the fence and the third man fielder had no chance of cutting it off.
Islam bowls it full and outside off. Janneman Malan looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards the mid on fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. Malan stays back and defends it to the off side.

Aerial but safe! A short ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to cut hard but it goes off the thick outside edge and the ball flies towards the third man region. The fielder there, runs in and dives in front to grab it but the ball falls just short of him. The batters take a run.
Back of a length, around off. Quinton de Kock hangs back and dabs it towards point.
Fizz drags his length back slightly, on off. Janneman Malan gets behind the line and keeps it out. 6 runs off Mustafizur Rahman's first over.
A length ball this time, in that channel around off. Janneman Malan covers the line and defends it solidly.
Fuller in length, around the fifth stump channel. Janneman Malan gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Better line from Mustafizur Rahman! Good-length delivery, around off. Janneman Malan leans and defends it onto the deck.
Good running! On a length, around leg. Janneman Malan tucks it around the corner and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! Top shot! Rahman starts with a full ball, around off. Janneman Malan prods and carves it through the cover region. The ball races away to the fence.
Short of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan rides the bounce and steers it to third man for a single.
Who will start from the other end? It is Mustafizur Rahman.
Wide! Islam hurls a wayward ball, well outside off. Janneman Malan does not bother playing at it and the umpire signals wide.
A length ball, bit of extra bounce, Malan shuffles across and defends it to mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Janneman Malan keeps it out.
On a length and outside off. Janneman Malan lets it be.

Bangladesh burn their review early on in the innings! Islam runs in and serves a good-length ball, around off that jags away late. Janneman Malan has a poke at it but he misses and the ball goes through to the keeper. Shoriful Islam appeals for a caught behind and convinces his skipper to opt for a review. They go up but the UltraEdge confirms that there was clear daylight between bat and ball. The on-field decision stands.
Islam starts with a length ball, just outside off. Janneman Malan prods but leaves it alone.

We are all set for the action. But first, both the teams will line up for their respective national anthems. It is Bangladesh's first followed by South Africa's. We are done with the proceedings and it is now time for the game to begin. The players will take the knee to support the 'BLM' movement.  Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan are the openers for the Proteas. Shoriful Islam to start with the ball. Two slips in place...

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock (WK), Kyle Verreynne, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius (In for Wayne Parnell), Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

After Bangladesh’s historic first ODI win, the Proteas came back strong on a difficult pitch, thanks to Rabada’s brilliance and de Kock’s quick heroics which helped them to level the series. A series win could mean another golden feather in the cap of Bangladesh’s cricketing voyage. The mix of experience and youth has done a superb job for Bangladesh and you can see the depth in their batting and also the improvement in their bowling. All in all, it is a very important match for both teams not just for the series but also for the points in the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Super League. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final ODI of the series between South Africa and Bangladesh. It is time for the decider and Bangladesh have a chance to create history to win the series for the first time on South African soil, while the hosts have never lost to the Bangla Tigers, so they will look to keep the procession intact. It is a do-or-die match as the team which wins will take the series home, the ODI series to be precise. Let's hope for a cracking contest here at SuperSport Park.
